# Command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/cli-reference.py from the command tree. Do not edit. -->

Every `jmap` command, with its arguments and options, as its `--help` gives them.
[Command line](cli.md) explains how to use them. Commands are in alphabetical order.

After you change a command, run `uv run python scripts/cli-reference.py` to
update this page. A test fails while it is stale.

## Global options

Each command takes these, before or after its own arguments.

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-a`, `--account` | `TEXT` | Named account to use. |
| `--account-id` | `TEXT` | JMAP account inside the session, by id or name. |
| `-o`, `--output` | `auto\|table\|plain\|json\|jsonl\|ids` | Output format. |
| `--json` |  | Same as -o json. |
| `--jsonl` |  | Same as -o jsonl. |
| `-q`, `--quiet` |  | No notes on stderr. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | Trace requests; -vv for more. |
| `--color` | `auto\|always\|never` | When to use colour. |
| `--no-keyring` |  | Neither read nor store secrets in the keyring. |
| `--experimental` |  | Resolve draft-tracking capabilities. |
| `--insecure` |  | Do not verify TLS certificates. |
| `--config` | `TEXT` | Configuration file. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Answer yes to confirmations. |
| `--version` |  | Show the version. |
| `--install-completion` |  | Install completion for the current shell. |
| `--show-completion` |  | Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation. |

## jmap account

Named accounts: servers and credentials.

### jmap account add

```text
jmap account add [OPTIONS] NAME
```

Add a named account, check it connects, and store its secret in the keyring.

With --auth oauth, sign in through the browser, or with --device on another
device. The global --account-id, --experimental and --insecure are stored too.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | The named account. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | `TEXT` | Session URL, or anything redirecting to it. |
| `--address` | `TEXT` | Email address; finds the server when --url is not given. |
| `--auth` | `TEXT` | password (the default), token, or oauth. |
| `--username` | `TEXT` | Login name; defaults to the address. |
| `--identity` | `TEXT` | Default From address. |
| `--ca-bundle` | `TEXT` | CA certificates to trust. |
| `--trust-srv` | `TEXT` | SRV target host to trust (repeatable). |
| `--default` |  | Make it the default. |
| `--password-stdin` |  | Read the password from stdin. |
| `--token-stdin` |  | Read the token from stdin. |
| `--no-verify` |  | Do not connect to check it. |
| `--force` |  | Replace an existing account. |
| `--device` |  | OAuth: sign in on another device, with a code. |
| `--no-browser` |  | OAuth: print the address instead of opening it. |
| `--client-id` | `TEXT` | OAuth client id; registered if empty. |
| `--scope` | `TEXT` | OAuth scope to ask for. |
| `--issuer` | `TEXT` | OAuth server; found from the server if empty. |

### jmap account list

```text
jmap account list [OPTIONS]
```

List the named accounts in the configuration file.

### jmap account login

```text
jmap account login [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

Sign in again: a new password or token, or a new OAuth token.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[NAME]` | The named account; the current one if omitted. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--password-stdin` |  | Read the password from stdin. |
| `--token-stdin` |  | Read the token from stdin. |
| `--no-verify` |  | Do not connect to check it. |
| `--device` |  | OAuth: sign in on another device, with a code. |
| `--no-browser` |  | OAuth: print the address instead of opening it. |

### jmap account remove

```text
jmap account remove [OPTIONS] NAME
```

Remove a named account and its stored secrets.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | The named account. Required. |

### jmap account set-default

```text
jmap account set-default [OPTIONS] NAME
```

Make a named account the one used when -a is not given.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | The named account. Required. |

### jmap account show

```text
jmap account show [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

List the JMAP accounts the server's session returns for a named account.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[NAME]` | The named account; the current one if omitted. |

### jmap account test

```text
jmap account test [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

Connect, call Core/echo, and report what the session says.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[NAME]` | The named account; the current one if omitted. |

## jmap addressbook

The collections contacts live in.

### jmap addressbook create

```text
jmap addressbook create [OPTIONS] NAME
```

Create an address book.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | The new address book's name. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--description` | `TEXT` | What it holds. |
| `--default` |  | Make it the default address book. |

### jmap addressbook delete

```text
jmap addressbook delete [OPTIONS] BOOK
```

Delete an address book. The server refuses one that holds cards, unless --with-contacts.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `BOOK` | The address book, by name or id. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--with-contacts` |  | Also destroy the cards in it. |

### jmap addressbook list

```text
jmap addressbook list [OPTIONS]
```

List your address books, the default marked.

### jmap addressbook rename

```text
jmap addressbook rename [OPTIONS] BOOK NAME
```

Rename an address book.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `BOOK` | The address book, by name or id. Required. |
| `NAME` | The new name. Required. |

## jmap api

Raw JMAP method calls.

### jmap api batch

```text
jmap api batch [OPTIONS] SOURCE
```

Make several calls in one request and print the responses as JSON.

An argument '#ids': {"resultOf": "q", "path": "/ids"} takes its value from the
result of the earlier call whose call id in this file is "q".

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | A JSON array of [method, arguments, callId], or - for stdin. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--using` | `TEXT` | Extra capability URN for 'using' (repeatable). |

### jmap api call

```text
jmap api call [OPTIONS] METHOD [ARGUMENTS]
```

Make one method call and print its response arguments as JSON.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `METHOD` | Method name, such as Mailbox/get. Required. |
| `[ARGUMENTS]` | JSON object of arguments, @FILE, or - for stdin. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--using` | `TEXT` | Extra capability URN for 'using' (repeatable). |

## jmap attachment

A message's files.

### jmap attachment download

```text
jmap attachment download [OPTIONS] MESSAGE [WHICH...]
```

Save attachments; a name already taken gets a number, unless --force.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `MESSAGE` | The message: a listing number or an id. Required. |
| `[WHICH...]` | Attachment numbers or names; all if --all. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--all` |  | Every attachment. |
| `--dir` | `PATH` | Where to save them. Default: `.`. |
| `--save` | `TEXT` | Save one attachment to this file, or - for stdout. |
| `--force` |  | Replace files that exist. |

### jmap attachment list

```text
jmap attachment list [OPTIONS] MESSAGE
```

List a message's attachments, numbered for 'attachment download'.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `MESSAGE` | The message: a listing number or an id. Required. |

## jmap blob

Upload, download and look up blobs.

### jmap blob copy

```text
jmap blob copy [OPTIONS] BLOBS...
```

Copy blobs from another JMAP account into this one.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `BLOBS...` | Blob ids. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--from-account` | `TEXT` | The JMAP account the blobs are in now. |

### jmap blob download

```text
jmap blob download [OPTIONS] BLOB
```

Download a blob's bytes.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `BLOB` | The blob id. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--save` | `TEXT` | Save to this file, or - for stdout (the default off a TTY). |
| `--name` | `TEXT` | The file name the server is told. Default: `download`. |
| `--type` | `TEXT` | The media type the server is told. Default: `application/octet-stream`. |
| `--force` |  | Replace a file that exists. |

### jmap blob info

```text
jmap blob info [OPTIONS] BLOBS...
```

Show each blob's size and, with --digest, its digests.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `BLOBS...` | Blob ids. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--digest` | `TEXT` | A digest to compute, such as sha-256 (repeatable). |

### jmap blob lookup

```text
jmap blob lookup [OPTIONS] BLOBS...
```

Show which objects refer to each blob.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `BLOBS...` | Blob ids. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--type` | `TEXT` | Data type to search, such as Email (repeatable). |

### jmap blob upload

```text
jmap blob upload [OPTIONS] SOURCE
```

Upload a file and print its blob id.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | A file, or - for stdin. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--type` | `TEXT` | Media type; guessed from the name if not given. |

## jmap calendar

Calendars (experimental).

### jmap calendar create

```text
jmap calendar create [OPTIONS] NAME
```

Create a calendar.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | The new calendar's name. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--css-color` | `TEXT` | Its color: red or #3366ff. |
| `--description` | `TEXT` | What it is for. |
| `--tz` | `TEXT` | Its time zone: Europe/London. |
| `--default` |  | Make it the default calendar. |

### jmap calendar delete

```text
jmap calendar delete [OPTIONS] CALENDAR
```

Delete a calendar, after you confirm. One with events needs --with-events.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `CALENDAR` | The calendar, by name or id. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--with-events` |  | Also delete the events in it. |

### jmap calendar list

```text
jmap calendar list [OPTIONS]
```

List your calendars.

### jmap calendar rename

```text
jmap calendar rename [OPTIONS] CALENDAR NAME
```

Rename a calendar.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `CALENDAR` | The calendar, by name or id. Required. |
| `NAME` | The new name. Required. |

## jmap changes

```text
jmap changes [OPTIONS] TYPE
```

List the ids created, updated and destroyed since a state.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `TYPE` | A data type, such as Email. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--since` | `TEXT` | The state to start from; the current one if not given. |
| `--max` | `N` | At most this many ids per page. |
| `--fetch` |  | Also get the created and updated objects. |

## jmap compose

```text
jmap compose [OPTIONS]
```

Write a message in your editor, then send it (or save it with --draft).

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--to` | `TEXT` | Recipient (repeatable, or a, b). |
| `--cc` | `TEXT` | Copy to (repeatable). |
| `--bcc` | `TEXT` | Blind copy to (repeatable). |
| `--subject` | `TEXT` | The subject. |
| `--body` | `TEXT` | The body text. |
| `--body-file` | `TEXT` | Read the body from a file, or - for stdin; it may start with headers. |
| `--attach` | `TEXT` | File to attach (repeatable). |
| `--from` | `TEXT` | Identity to send as, by address. |
| `--markdown` |  | The body is Markdown: send HTML. |
| `--html` |  | The body is HTML. |
| `--send-at` | `TEXT` | Hold until a time (2026-11-01T09:00) or for +2h, +1d. |
| `--keyword` | `TEXT` | Keyword to set. |
| `--draft` |  | Save it in Drafts, do not send. |
| `--edit` / `--no-edit` |  | Open the editor (the default on a terminal). |

## jmap config

The configuration file.

### jmap config edit

```text
jmap config edit [OPTIONS]
```

Open the configuration file in your editor, and check it afterwards.

### jmap config path

```text
jmap config path [OPTIONS]
```

Print where the configuration file is.

### jmap config set

```text
jmap config set [OPTIONS] KEY VALUE
```

Set one value in the configuration file: jmap config set defaults.output json.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `KEY` | Dotted key: defaults.output, accounts.work.identity. Required. |
| `VALUE` | A TOML value (true, 30, ["a"]) or plain text. Required. |

## jmap contact

List, show, create and edit contacts.

### jmap contact create

```text
jmap contact create [OPTIONS]
```

Create a contact card, in --book or the default address book.

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` | `TEXT` | The full name, as shown. |
| `--given` | `TEXT` | The given (first) name. |
| `--surname` | `TEXT` | The surname (family name). |
| `--email` | `TEXT` | An email address (repeatable). |
| `--phone` | `TEXT` | A phone number (repeatable). |
| `--org` | `TEXT` | The organization. |
| `--title` | `TEXT` | The job title. |
| `--note` | `TEXT` | A note. |
| `--kind` | `TEXT` | individual (the default), org, group, location... |
| `--book` | `TEXT` | The address book, by name or id. |

### jmap contact delete

```text
jmap contact delete [OPTIONS] CONTACTS...
```

Delete contact cards, after you confirm.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `CONTACTS...` | Numbers from the last 'contact list', ids, or addresses. Required. |

### jmap contact edit

```text
jmap contact edit [OPTIONS] CONTACT
```

Edit a contact card's JSON in your editor; only what you change is sent.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `CONTACT` | The card: a listing number, an id, or an address. Required. |

### jmap contact import

```text
jmap contact import [OPTIONS] SOURCE
```

Add the cards in a vCard file to --book or the default address book.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | A vCard file (.vcf), or - for stdin. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--book` | `TEXT` | The address book, by name or id. |

### jmap contact list

```text
jmap contact list [OPTIONS] [TEXT]
```

List contact cards, or those that match TEXT.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[TEXT]` | Only cards that mention this. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--book` | `TEXT` | The address book, by name or id. |
| `--sort` | `TEXT` | surname, given, created or updated; a leading - reverses it. |
| `-n`, `--limit` | `N` | Cards to show. Default: `100`. |

### jmap contact show

```text
jmap contact show [OPTIONS] CONTACT
```

Show one contact card: every address, number and note.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `CONTACT` | The card: a listing number, an id, or an address. Required. |

## jmap draft

Messages saved to finish later.

### jmap draft delete

```text
jmap draft delete [OPTIONS] DRAFTS...
```

Delete drafts, after you confirm.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DRAFTS...` | Numbers from the last listing, or ids. Required. |

### jmap draft edit

```text
jmap draft edit [OPTIONS] DRAFT
```

Edit a draft in your editor; the old one is replaced.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DRAFT` | The draft: a listing number or an id. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--send` |  | Send it once edited. |

### jmap draft list

```text
jmap draft list [OPTIONS]
```

List the drafts, newest first, numbered.

### jmap draft new

```text
jmap draft new [OPTIONS]
```

Write a message and save it to Drafts without sending it.

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--to` | `TEXT` | Recipient (repeatable, or a, b). |
| `--cc` | `TEXT` | Copy to (repeatable). |
| `--bcc` | `TEXT` | Blind copy to (repeatable). |
| `--subject` | `TEXT` | The subject. |
| `--body` | `TEXT` | The body text. |
| `--body-file` | `TEXT` | Read the body from a file, or - for stdin; it may start with headers. |
| `--attach` | `TEXT` | File to attach (repeatable). |
| `--from` | `TEXT` | Identity to send as, by address. |
| `--edit` / `--no-edit` |  | Open the editor (the default on a terminal). |

### jmap draft send

```text
jmap draft send [OPTIONS] DRAFT
```

Send a draft as it is.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DRAFT` | The draft: a listing number or an id. Required. |

## jmap event

Calendar events (experimental).

### jmap event create

```text
jmap event create [OPTIONS] TITLE
```

Create an event, one hour long unless you say otherwise.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `TITLE` | What the event is called. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--start` | `TEXT` | When it starts: 2026-11-01T09:30, tomorrow. |
| `--duration` | `TEXT` | How long: 45m, 1h30m, 2d. |
| `--end` | `TEXT` | When it ends, instead. |
| `--all-day` |  | Whole days, no time. |
| `--tz` | `TEXT` | The time zone: Europe/London. Default: this machine's. |
| `--calendar` | `TEXT` | The calendar, by name or id. |
| `--location` | `TEXT` | Where it is. |
| `--description` | `TEXT` | What it is about. |
| `--rrule` | `TEXT` | How it repeats: weekly, FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=5. |
| `--alert` | `TEXT` | Remind this long before: 15m (repeatable). |
| `--attendee` | `TEXT` | Invite this address (repeatable). |
| `--send-invites` |  | Email the attendees about it. |

### jmap event delete

```text
jmap event delete [OPTIONS] EVENT
```

Delete an event, after you confirm. One occurrence needs --this-occurrence.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `EVENT` | The event's id, as 'jmap event list' shows it. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--this-occurrence` |  | Change only this occurrence of a repeating event. |

### jmap event import

```text
jmap event import [OPTIONS] SOURCE
```

Add the events in an iCalendar file to a calendar.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | An iCalendar file (.ics), or - for stdin. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--calendar` | `TEXT` | The calendar, by name or id. |

### jmap event list

```text
jmap event list [OPTIONS]
```

List events in a window of time, each occurrence of a repeating one on its own row.

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--from` | `TEXT` | Start: today, tomorrow, +2d, 2026-11-01T09:00. Default: `today`. |
| `--to` | `TEXT` | End; +7d counts from --from. Default: `+7d`. |
| `--calendar` | `TEXT` | Only this calendar (repeatable). |
| `--tz` | `TEXT` | The time zone: Europe/London. Default: this machine's. |
| `--no-expand` |  | One row per repeating event, not per occurrence. |

### jmap event notifications

```text
jmap event notifications [OPTIONS]
```

List what others changed in events you can see, or clear the list.

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--clear` |  | Delete them all instead. |

### jmap event show

```text
jmap event show [OPTIONS] EVENT
```

Show one event: when, where, who, and how it repeats.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `EVENT` | The event's id, as 'jmap event list' shows it. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--tz` | `TEXT` | The time zone: Europe/London. Default: this machine's. |

### jmap event update

```text
jmap event update [OPTIONS] EVENT
```

Change an event; only what you give changes. One occurrence needs --this-occurrence.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `EVENT` | The event's id, as 'jmap event list' shows it. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--title` | `TEXT` | A new title. |
| `--start` | `TEXT` | When it starts: 2026-11-01T09:30, tomorrow. |
| `--duration` | `TEXT` | How long: 45m, 1h30m, 2d. |
| `--tz` | `TEXT` | Move it to this time zone. |
| `--location` | `TEXT` | Where it is. |
| `--description` | `TEXT` | What it is about. |
| `--status` | `TEXT` | confirmed, tentative or cancelled. |
| `--calendar` | `TEXT` | The calendar, by name or id. |
| `--send-invites` |  | Email the attendees about it. |
| `--this-occurrence` |  | Change only this occurrence of a repeating event. |

## jmap file

Files stored on the server (experimental).

### jmap file download

```text
jmap file download [OPTIONS] PATH
```

Download a file; a name already taken gets a number, unless --force.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | A path on the server: /Projects/notes.txt. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `PATH` | Save it here. Default: `.`. |
| `--save` | `TEXT` | Save it to this file, or - for stdout. |
| `--force` |  | Replace a file that exists. |

### jmap file ls

```text
jmap file ls [OPTIONS] [PATH]
```

List a directory, directories first.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[PATH]` | A directory. Default: `/`. |

### jmap file mkdir

```text
jmap file mkdir [OPTIONS] PATH
```

Create a directory.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | A path on the server: /Projects/notes.txt. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--parents`, `-p` |  | Create missing parents too. |

### jmap file mv

```text
jmap file mv [OPTIONS] SOURCE TARGET
```

Move or rename a file or directory.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | A path on the server: /Projects/notes.txt. Required. |
| `TARGET` | A directory to move it into, or a new path. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--replace` |  | Replace a file of the same name. |

### jmap file rm

```text
jmap file rm [OPTIONS] PATH
```

Delete a file or an empty directory, after you confirm.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | A path on the server: /Projects/notes.txt. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--recursive`, `-r` |  | Delete a directory and all inside it. |

### jmap file tree

```text
jmap file tree [OPTIONS] [PATH]
```

Show a directory and everything below it, indented.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[PATH]` | Where to start. Default: `/`. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--depth` | `N` | How many levels down. Default: `10`. |

### jmap file upload

```text
jmap file upload [OPTIONS] SOURCE [TARGET]
```

Upload a file.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | The local file. Required. |
| `[TARGET]` | Where: a directory, or a new path. Default: the top level. Default: `/`. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--replace` |  | Replace a file of the same name. |

## jmap forward

```text
jmap forward [OPTIONS] MESSAGE
```

Forward a message with its attachments, and mark it forwarded when sent.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `MESSAGE` | The message: a listing number or an id. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--to` | `TEXT` | Recipient (repeatable, or a, b). |
| `--cc` | `TEXT` | Copy to (repeatable). |
| `--bcc` | `TEXT` | Blind copy to (repeatable). |
| `--attach-original` |  | Attach it whole, as a .eml file. |

| `--flagged` |  | Only flagged mail. |
| `--attachment` |  | Only mail with files. |
| `--before` | `TEXT` | Received before: 2025-01-31, 7d. |
| `--after` | `TEXT` | Received after: 2025-01-31, today. |
| `--sort` | `TEXT` | Comma list: -date, subject, from, size, flagged. Default: `-date`. |
| `-n`, `--limit` | `N` | Messages per page. Default: `25`. |
| `--page` | `N` | Which page of --limit messages. Default: `1`. |
| `--all` |  | Every match, page after page. |
| `--count` |  | Print the number of matches. |
| `--threads` |  | One row per conversation. |
| `--anchor` | `TEXT` | Start the page at this message: a listing number or an id. |
| `--anchor-offset` | `N` | Start this many messages after --anchor; negative is before. |
| `--columns` | `TEXT` | Comma list: flags, date, from, to, subject, preview, size, id, thread. |

### jmap sieve activate


Make a script the active one.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SCRIPT` | The script, by name or id. Required. |

### jmap sieve deactivate

```text
jmap sieve deactivate [OPTIONS]
```

Turn filtering off: no script is active after this.

### jmap sieve delete

```text
jmap sieve delete [OPTIONS] SCRIPT
```

Delete a script, after you confirm; an active one is deactivated first.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SCRIPT` | The script, by name or id. Required. |

### jmap sieve get

```text
jmap sieve get [OPTIONS] SCRIPT
```

Print a script's text.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SCRIPT` | The script, by name or id. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--save` | `TEXT` | Save to this file instead. |
| `--force` |  | Replace a file that exists. |

### jmap sieve list

```text
jmap sieve list [OPTIONS]
```

List the scripts; at most one is active.

### jmap sieve put

```text
jmap sieve put [OPTIONS] SOURCE
```

Store a script, replacing the one of the same name.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | A Sieve file, or - for stdin. Required. |

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` | `TEXT` | The script's name; the file's name if not given. |
| `--activate` |  | Make it the active one. |
| `--validate` / `--no-validate` |  | Check it before storing it. Default: `--validate`. |

### jmap sieve validate

```text
jmap sieve validate [OPTIONS] SOURCE
```

Check a script without storing it; exits 2 if it is not valid.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | A Sieve file, or - for stdin. Required. |

## jmap submission

Sent and held messages.

### jmap submission cancel

```text
jmap submission cancel [OPTIONS] SUBMISSION
```

Cancel a submission that has not gone yet, such as one held with --send-at.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SUBMISSION` | The submission id. Required. |

### jmap submission list

```text
jmap submission list [OPTIONS]
```

List submissions, with each message's subject.

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pending` |  | Only those that can still be cancelled. |

### jmap submission show

```text
jmap submission show [OPTIONS] SUBMISSION
```

Show one submission: its status, envelope and delivery.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `SUBMISSION` | The submission id. Required. |

## jmap vacation

The automatic reply while away.

### jmap vacation disable

```text
jmap vacation disable [OPTIONS]
```

Switch the vacation response off.

### jmap vacation enable

```text
jmap vacation enable [OPTIONS]
```

Switch the vacation response on.

### jmap vacation set

```text
jmap vacation set [OPTIONS]
```

Change the vacation response; only what you give changes.

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--subject` | `TEXT` | The reply's subject. |
| `--body` | `TEXT` | The reply's text. |
| `--body-file` | `TEXT` | Read the text from a file. |
| `--html` | `TEXT` | An HTML version of the text. |
| `--from` | `TEXT` | Start: 2026-12-20T00:00:00Z. |
| `--until` | `TEXT` | End, in the same form. |
| `--enable` / `--disable` |  | Switch it on or off. |

### jmap vacation show

```text
jmap vacation show [OPTIONS]
```

Show the vacation response.

## jmap watch

```text
jmap watch [OPTIONS]
```

Print changes as the server announces them, until Ctrl-C.

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--types` | `TEXT` | Types to watch, such as Email,Mailbox; every type if not given. |
| `--ping` | `N` | Ask for a keep-alive this often, in seconds. Default: `30`. |
| `--exec` | `TEXT` | Run this for each change, with the event on stdin. |
| `--new-mail` |  | Print one line for each new message. |
| `--match` | `TEXT` | With --new-mail: only messages this search finds. |
